title: When the Prior Is Wrong: Probing Misspecified Diffusion Priors in Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2604.21066v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While diffusion priors generate high-quality posterior samples across many scientific inverse problems, they are often trained on purely simulated data, thus inheriting the errors and biases of these underlying sources. Many approaches to adapting diffusion priors from a single observation require sufficient conflict between the data and the prior to successfully adapt and do not allow specific misspecification hypotheses to be tested. On the other hand, existing out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods determine whether the observation is compatible with a fixed prior, rather than specifying which assumptions to relax or by how much. To address these issues, we propose PIVOT: Prior Inference Via Observation-driven Transformations, which formulates diffusion prior misspecification as inference over an underlying latent variable representing a scientifically plausible discrepancy. translated_abstract: 虽然扩散先验在许多科学逆问题中能够生成高质量的后验样本，但它们通常是在纯模拟数据上训练的，因此会继承这些底层模拟来源的误差与偏差。许多从单次观测中调整扩散先验的方法，需要数据与先验之间存在足够的冲突才能成功适应，且无法对特定的错误设定假设进行检验。另一方面，现有的分布外（OOD）检测方法仅能判断观测结果是否与固定先验兼容，而无法指明应放宽哪些假设或放宽到何种程度。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 PIVOT（Prior Inference Via Observation-driven Transformations，基于观测驱动变换的先验推断），该方法将扩散先验的错误设定表述为对一个潜在变量的推断，该潜在变量代表一种科学上合理的偏差。通过沿这些合理的偏差方向扩展先验……
tldr: 该论文提出 PIVOT 方法，将扩散先验的错误设定建模为对代表科学合理偏差的潜在变量进行推断，从而能从单次观测中识别先验中哪些假设需要放宽以及放宽的程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PIVOT, which formulates diffusion prior misspecification as inference over a latent variable representing a scientifically plausible discrepancy, enabling identification of which prior assumptions to relax and by how much from a single observation.
